map.织物 1000 g、染色深度 3% o.w.f、浴比 1:10 → 染料用量 3: Fabric 1000 g, shade depth 3% o.w.f, liquor ratio 1:10 → dye dosage 30 g; total liquor 1000×10=10000 mL (10 L), liquor concentration 30 g/10 L=3 g/L.
map.on weight of fibre/fabric 的缩写，表示染料或助剂用量相: An abbreviation of on weight of fibre/fabric, meaning the percentage of dye or auxiliary dosage relative to the dry fabric weight — the most commonly used metering basis in dyeing and printing.
map.染料力份不同怎么修正？: How is it corrected when dye strength differs?
map.实际用量 = 标准用量 ÷ 力份(%)。力份 100% 按标称，力份 80% 则: Actual dosage = standard dosage ÷ strength(%). At 100% strength use the nominal figure; at 80% strength multiply the dosage by 1/0.8. The tool should support a strength correction or you can convert it yourself.
map.浴比影响大吗？: Does the liquor ratio matter much?
map.浴比决定染液量与浓度，影响得色深度与匀染性；小浴比省水节能但匀染难度上升，需配合: The liquor ratio determines liquor volume and concentration, which affect shade depth and levelness; a small ratio saves water and energy but makes levelling harder and requires auxiliaries and suitable equipment.
map.染料用量计算器基于 % o.w.f（对织物重）计量方式，输入织物重量与染料浓度即: The dye dosage calculator is based on the % o.w.f (on fabric weight) metering method. Enter the fabric weight and dye concentration to quickly obtain the dye dosage, and combine it with the liquor ratio to compute total liquor volume and liquor concentration. It suits exhaust lab dips and bulk production liquor preparation.
map.同步输出染料用量(g/kg)、染液总量、染液浓度: Outputs dye dosage (g/kg), total liquor volume and liquor concentration together
